user_input: Does the new policy count PRP, cool-off periods, and personal breaks as part of the program duration?
retrieved_contexts:
['# **<u>BROCAMP NEW CONDONATION POLICY MIGRATION GUIDELINES</u>**  
1. Candidates who migrate to the new condonation policy can continue their learning journey without any further condonation fees until they reach their respective maximum program duration specified in this document. It allows candidates to focus on consistent learning and timely completion within a clearly defined duration.  
2. After successful migration, the maximum allowed duration of the program will be:  
- A. Premium 1-Year Program: 2.5 Years (30 Months)  
- B. Old 1-Year Program: 2 Years (24 Months)  
- C. 7-Month Program: 1.5 Years (18 Months)  
This timeline supports a deeper understanding, revision, and confident program completion.  
3. Duration Calculation  
- A. Premium 1-Year Program, duration is calculated from the Foundation Start Date.  
- B. Old 1-Year Program and 7-Month Program, duration is calculated from the Batch Intake Date.  
3.1 The program duration already includes sufficient buffers to support smooth and timely completion, as continuous progress plays a key role in effective learning and long-term outcomes. Any pauses due to personal reasons, review holds, delays, PRP, refresh periods, cool-off periods, or similar situations will be counted within the allowed program duration and will not be excluded or extended.  
4. Continuation Beyond Maximum Duration  
- 4.1 Even after providing a sufficiently long duration within the program, if any candidates require additional time to complete the program, they may continue by paying per pending module (week) as mentioned below:  
A. Premium 1-Year Program: ₹5,000 per module  
B. Old 1-Year Program: ₹4,000 per module  
C. 7-Month Program: ₹4,000 per module  
- 4.2 Payment must be made as a single, one-time payment covering all pending  
modules, and for each paid module (week),  a duration of two weeks will be granted, during which no condonation fees will apply.  
5. General  
5.1 The term “week” will be referred to as “module” for better clarity.  
5.2 Once migration is completed, reversion to the old policy is restricted to ensure uninterrupted operational flow and standardized program management.', 'modules, and for each paid module (week),  a duration of two weeks will be granted, during which no condonation fees will apply.  
5. General  
5.1 The term “week” will be referred to as “module” for better clarity.  
5.2 Once migration is completed, reversion to the old policy is restricted to ensure uninterrupted operational flow and standardized program management.  
5.3 To ensure smooth review scheduling and efficient use of reviewer and review coordinator time, candidates are required to inform the Batch Counsellor at least two days in advance if they wish to cancel the review. This helps avoid unused reviewer slots and disruptions to review planning. Unauthorized review cancellations result in a fine of ₹1,000/-.  
5.4 Absence from reviews is not permitted, except in cases of genuine emergencies (e.g., Hospitalisation). If a candidate is absent for two consecutive reviews, a written explanation with supporting documents must be submitted via email within three (3) days. If no response is received or the explanation is found to be unsatisfactory, a video call with the parent may be arranged. The candidate may attend subsequent reviews only after completing this process.  
It will encourage continuous participation in the program, prevent unnecessary absences, ensure accountability, support effective review planning, and enable efficient utilization of the program resources.  
5.5 The new policy follows a fixed duration and does not include bonus weeks, as the program already provides a sufficiently extended timeline and a structured framework to ensure consistent progress and smooth program completion.  
5.6 The money-back policy terms for Premium 1-Year Program candidates will remain the same after migration  
I hereby acknowledge that by signing this document, I have read, understood, and agreed to comply with all program policies and guidelines, confirm that I am mentally and physically prepared for full engagement and focused learning, and voluntarily accept the new policy structure, including its rules, benefits, and processes, without dispute or request for reversal.  
Student Name: Date: Signature:']
